title: Paragliding San Francisco
specs: Open-air soaring over the Pacific surf
gap: Exact meeting point address not stated
blurb: Paragliding flights are tandem with a certified pilot at Mussel Rock, Daly City, 15 minutes from San Francisco. Flights last about 20 to 30 minutes in the air with no hard time limit. The pilot does all the flying; guests can take the brakes if they want.

hoursText: Open 7 days a week, 8:00 AM - 9:00 PM
